title: Battle of Listerdyb
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Listerdyb", at revision 1370447755, opens: "This battle took place on 16 May 1644 during the Danish-Swedish War near List Deep, between Sylt and Rømø in western Denmark. Nine Danish ships under King Christian IV forced a retreat back into List Deep of 26 smaller Dutch ships which had been leased to Sweden. 4 more Dutch ships from Marcus' squadron appeared during the battle but took no part." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q551218, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1644 naval battle of the Danish-Swedish War". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
